messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed in eu3 edge gateway (gateway-eu3-proxy). Threshold triggered: 5xx > 8% for 2m. Tags: region=eu3, service=gateway, priority=P1

devon (oncall): on it. paging infra + runtime. starting triage — pulling gateway logs and envoy stats.

sara (infra): I see a strong spike in 502/503 from gateway-eu3-proxy -> envoy upstream cluster 'model-backends-eu3'. connection_reset and 503 "no healthy upstream" around 12:07UTC.

maria (runtime): checking pods in eu3 model pool. Some replicas are OOM-killed and in CrashLoopBackOff. K8s shows high restart_count on model-replica-7/8/9. Memory usage jumped ~3x over baseline.

kenji (platform): rolling autoscaler hasn't scaled fast enough; scaling policy for eu3 uses 90th P95 CPU as trigger. I'm going to bump target temporarily to force scale up while we triage.

devon (oncall): quick health checks: `curl -sS -D - https://gateway-eu3.internal/health | head -n 20` -> 200 on the gateway, but proxying /generate returns 502.

sara (infra): envoy logs (tail):
```
[2026-03-15T12:06:42Z] upstream reset: connection failure, remote closed
[2026-03-15T12:06:43Z] no healthy upstream: cluster model-backends-eu3
[2026-03-15T12:07:01Z] 502 response to client, upstream status 503
```
Looks like the gateway was seeing upstream nodes unhealthy.

maria (runtime): model pods are hitting mem spikes due to a bad quantization path on model v2.3.4 edge variant. We're reverting that variant immediately for eu3. Initiating config roll to previous quant profile.

devon (oncall): are we able to shift traffic away from eu3 while we fix? we should reduce customer impact.

kenji (platform): I can adjust route weights in route-manager. Plan: reduce eu3 traffic to 20% and increase eu1/usw2 accordingly. Will do weighted shift in 60s. Command: `route-manager set-weight gateway-eu3 0.2 && route-manager set-weight gateway-eu1 0.5 && route-manager set-weight gateway-usw2 0.3`

ops-bot: executed by kenji at 12:09:24Z. new weights applied. Monitoring for 2m.

devon (oncall): good. watching global 5xx and latency dashboards. initial traffic shift shows 5xx for customers routing to eu3 dropping but global 5xx still ~5% -> trending down.

sara (infra): rolling restart of the 3 crashing model pods in eu3 started (kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-backends-eu3). pod logs show the quant code path failing on certain batch sizes; restart keeps pods healthy so far.

maria (runtime): reverting model variant in the catalog for eu3 complete. Config change: `model-service set-variant --model-id rw-llama-2 --region eu3 --variant v2.3.3`. Confirmed successful on control plane.

devon (oncall): customers impacted: telemetry shows ~0.9% of total requests got 502/503 during spike window. Major PLG customers in EU saw intermittent errors ~12:06-12:25UTC. Support ticket 7892 created and linked.

kenji (platform): autoscaler bumped target; added 6 instances to eu3 model pool. New pods healthy. CPU and memory back to baseline.

maria (runtime): after revert + restarts, upstream health restored, envoy reporting healthy upstream count 12 -> 12. Doing a smoke test: `for i in {1..10}; do curl -sS -X POST https://gateway-eu3.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' | jq .status; done` -> all 200.

devon (oncall): global 5xx dropped to 0.6% and still decreasing. latency P95 stable. Rolling back weight change? Recommend gradual return to standard weights after 15m observation.

kenji (platform): moving weights back to default: `route-manager set-weight gateway-eu3 0.45 && route-manager set-weight gateway-eu1 0.3 && route-manager set-weight gateway-usw2 0.25` — applied at 12:22:58Z.

ops-bot: traffic weights restored. No errors observed in the last 3m.

maria (runtime): root cause: model variant v2.3.4 introduced a regression with a quantized op for certain batch sizes causing memory blowup and pod restarts under production load. Impact surface: eu3 had that variant pinned. We'll push a hotfix to variant validation & add memory guardrails.

sara (infra): followups: 1) add circuit-breaker threshold on envoy cluster to avoid "no healthy upstreams" visible to clients (fail fast). 2) add an autoscaler policy emergency path for faster scale when pod restarts spike. 3) add an alert rule to detect variant-specific crashloops.

devon (oncall): civil note for post-incident: incident lasted ~19m from first alert to restored traffic weights; customer-facing impact window ~19m with ~0.9% error rate on affected requests. We'll create incident postmortem and link to support ticket 7892. Assign to maria+kenji+sara for remediation.

kenji (platform): handing off to next oncall for 12:45UTC shift. @devon staying as incident lead for postmortem writeup.

devon (oncall): ack. I'll file the postmortem draft and timeline, and include logs/commands we ran. If anyone has screenshots or Grafana links, paste them here.

maria (runtime): saved relevant pod logs to /logs/incidents/2102467890/model-pods.log and uploaded flame graphs to the incident folder.

sara (infra): reopening alert suppression for eu3 for 30m to avoid noise while we finalize fixes.

ops-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Incident ticket: INC-2102467890 created.

devon (oncall): thanks team. will update slack #status when postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
